name: meeting
trans: n. 会议，集会；会面，见面；汇合点，交叉点
example: We discussed meeting during today's meeting.
exampleTrans: 我们在今天的会议中讨论了meeting。

name: agenda
trans: n. 议程，待办事项；隐藏的动机或计划
example: We discussed agenda during today's meeting.
exampleTrans: 我们在今天的会议中讨论了agenda。

name: action item
example: Please send the action items from today's meeting.
exampleTrans: 请把今天会议的行动项发出来。

name: follow up
example: I'll follow up with legal about the data retention policy.
exampleTrans: 我会跟法务跟进数据保留政策的事。

name: takeaway
example: The main takeaway is that users don't trust automatic categories.
exampleTrans: 主要结论是用户不信任自动分类。

name: recap
example: I'll send a quick recap of the decisions after the call.
exampleTrans: 会后我会发一份决策要点的简要总结。

name: sync
example: Let's have a quick sync with marketing about the launch email.
exampleTrans: 我们和市场部快速同步一下上线邮件的事。

name: heads-up
example: Just a heads-up that the release might slip by two days.
exampleTrans: 提前说一声，发版可能会推迟两天。

name: alignment
example: This meeting is to get alignment on the launch date.
exampleTrans: 这次会议是为了就上线日期达成一致。

name: align
example: Let's align with the design team before we finalize the spec.
exampleTrans: 定稿需求前我们先和设计团队对齐一下。

name: stakeholder
example: We need sign-off from every key stakeholder before launch.
exampleTrans: 上线前我们需要每位关键干系人的签字确认。

name: priority
example: Payment bugs are our top priority for this release.
exampleTrans: 支付相关的缺陷是本次发版的最高优先级。

name: prioritize
example: We prioritize features by user impact and engineering effort.
exampleTrans: 我们根据用户影响和研发工作量给功能排优先级。

name: deadline
example: The deadline for the payment migration has been moved to next Friday.
exampleTrans: 支付迁移的截止日期推迟到了下周五。

name: estimate
example: Engineering's estimate for this feature is about three weeks.
exampleTrans: 研发对这个功能的估算大约是三周。

name: effort
example: This change is low effort but high impact.
exampleTrans: 这个改动工作量小但影响大。

name: impact
example: We ranked the ideas by expected impact on revenue.
exampleTrans: 我们按对收入的预期影响给这些想法排序。

name: resource
example: We don't have enough resources to build both features this quarter.
exampleTrans: 本季度我们没有足够的人力同时做这两个功能。

name: bandwidth
example: Does the mobile team have bandwidth for this request?
exampleTrans: 移动端团队有余力处理这个需求吗？

name: blocker
example: The missing API key is a blocker for the integration work.
exampleTrans: 缺少 API 密钥是集成工作的阻塞问题。

name: risk
example: The biggest risk is that the partner API changes before launch.
exampleTrans: 最大的风险是合作方接口在上线前发生变化。

name: mitigate
example: We can mitigate the risk with a feature flag and gradual rollout.
exampleTrans: 我们可以用功能开关和灰度发布来降低风险。

name: deliverable
example: The main deliverable this month is the updated checkout flow.
exampleTrans: 本月的主要交付物是更新后的结账流程。

name: timeline
example: The timeline assumes design is finished by the end of May.
exampleTrans: 这个排期假设设计在五月底前完成。

name: initiative
example: This initiative aims to cut support tickets by half.
exampleTrans: 这项举措旨在把客服工单减少一半。

name: objective
example: The objective of this release is to improve first-time activation.
exampleTrans: 这次发版的目标是提高首次激活率。

name: milestone
example: Finishing the beta is the next major milestone.
exampleTrans: 完成公测版本是下一个重要里程碑。

name: roadmap
example: We updated the roadmap after the quarterly planning meeting.
exampleTrans: 季度规划会后我们更新了产品路线图。

name: scope
example: Let's keep the scope small so we can ship this sprint.
exampleTrans: 我们把范围控制小一点，这样本迭代就能发布。

name: out of scope
example: Offline mode is out of scope for the first release.
exampleTrans: 离线模式不在首个版本的范围内。

name: scope creep
example: Adding reports late in the sprint is classic scope creep.
exampleTrans: 在迭代后期加报表需求是典型的范围蔓延。

name: requirement
example: Please list every requirement in the PRD before the design review.
exampleTrans: 设计评审前请在 PRD 中列出每一条需求。

name: specification
example: The API specification must be finalized before the frontend starts.
exampleTrans: 前端开工前必须定稿接口规格说明。

name: proposal
example: The proposal compares three options for the new pricing model.
exampleTrans: 这份提案比较了新定价模式的三种方案。

name: brief
example: I wrote a short brief for the design team.
exampleTrans: 我为设计团队写了一份简短的需求简报。

name: one-pager
example: Send me a one-pager explaining the opportunity and the cost.
exampleTrans: 给我发一份一页纸方案，说明机会和成本。

name: rationale
example: Please add the rationale behind each priority in the doc.
exampleTrans: 请在文档中补充每个优先级背后的理由。

name: decision log
example: Update the decision log after stakeholders approve the revised scope.
exampleTrans: 干系人批准调整后的范围后，请更新决策记录。

name: owner
example: Who is the owner of the notification settings page?
exampleTrans: 通知设置页的负责人是谁？

name: ownership
example: She took ownership of the onboarding metrics this quarter.
exampleTrans: 她本季度负责新手引导相关指标。

name: accountable
example: The PM is accountable for the success of the launch.
exampleTrans: 产品经理对这次上线的成败负责。

name: cross-functional
example: We built a cross-functional team with design, data and engineering.
exampleTrans: 我们组建了一个包括设计、数据和研发的跨职能团队。

name: escalate
example: If the vendor misses the date again, we should escalate.
exampleTrans: 如果供应商再次延期，我们应该上报。

name: unblock
example: Can someone from security unblock the data access request?
exampleTrans: 安全团队能有人帮忙解除这个数据访问请求的阻塞吗？

name: feedback
example: We collected feedback from twenty customers during the pilot.
exampleTrans: 试点期间我们收集了二十位客户的反馈。

name: review
example: Please review the wireframes and leave comments by tomorrow.
exampleTrans: 请在明天前审阅线框图并留下评论。

name: sign-off
example: We still need legal sign-off on the privacy policy changes.
exampleTrans: 隐私政策的修改还需要法务签字确认。

name: kickoff
example: The project kickoff is on Monday with design and engineering.
exampleTrans: 项目启动会定在周一，设计和研发都会参加。

name: standup
example: Raise blockers in the daily standup, not at the end of the sprint.
exampleTrans: 在每日站会上提出阻塞问题，而不是到迭代末尾。

name: retrospective
example: In the retrospective we agreed to write specs earlier.
exampleTrans: 在回顾会上我们约定要更早写需求说明。

name: refinement
example: We clarified the edge cases during the refinement session.
exampleTrans: 我们在需求细化会上澄清了边界情况。

name: sprint
example: We committed to eight stories for this sprint.
exampleTrans: 这个迭代我们承诺完成八个用户故事。

name: backlog
example: I moved the export feature back into the backlog.
exampleTrans: 我把导出功能挪回了需求池。

name: ticket
example: Please create a ticket and link it to the epic.
exampleTrans: 请创建一个工单并关联到对应的史诗。

name: status update
example: I send a weekly status update to all stakeholders.
exampleTrans: 我每周向所有干系人发送进展更新。

name: on track
example: The mobile release is on track for the end of the month.
exampleTrans: 移动端版本按计划将在月底发布。

name: at risk
example: The integration milestone is at risk due to vendor delays.
exampleTrans: 由于供应商延期，集成里程碑存在风险。

name: slip
example: The launch slipped a week because of a security review.
exampleTrans: 由于安全评审，上线推迟了一周。

name: deprioritize
example: We deprioritized the export feature to focus on reliability.
exampleTrans: 我们降低了导出功能的优先级，以专注于稳定性。

name: descope
example: We descoped the admin panel to hit the launch date.
exampleTrans: 为了赶上线日期，我们砍掉了管理后台。

name: quick win
example: Fixing the confusing button label is an easy quick win.
exampleTrans: 修改令人困惑的按钮文案是个容易的速赢项。

name: dependency
example: This project has a dependency on the new payment API.
exampleTrans: 这个项目依赖新的支付接口。

name: bottleneck
example: Manual review is the bottleneck in our approval process.
exampleTrans: 人工审核是我们审批流程的瓶颈。

name: handoff
example: The design handoff includes specs for every screen state.
exampleTrans: 设计交接包含每个页面状态的标注。

name: onboarding
example: A better onboarding flow could reduce first-week churn.
exampleTrans: 更好的新手引导流程可以降低首周流失。

name: training
trans: n. 训练，培训；锻炼，体能训练；教育，培养
example: We discussed training during today's meeting.
exampleTrans: 我们在今天的会议中讨论了training。

name: documentation
example: The documentation is out of date, so I'll update it after this change.
exampleTrans: 文档已经过时了，这次改完后我来更新。

name: walkthrough
example: Let's do a walkthrough of the spec with the whole team.
exampleTrans: 我们和全队一起过一遍需求说明。

name: deep dive
example: Next week we'll do a deep dive into the churn data.
exampleTrans: 下周我们会深入分析流失数据。

name: demo
example: I will demo the new workflow at the all-hands meeting.
exampleTrans: 我会在全员大会上演示新的工作流程。

name: presentation
trans: n. 提供， 显示； 外观， 图像； 授予， 赠送； 报告， 介绍； 表演
example: We discussed presentation during today's meeting.
exampleTrans: 我们在今天的会议中讨论了presentation。

name: dashboard
example: The growth dashboard shows signups, activation and retention daily.
exampleTrans: 增长看板每天展示注册、激活和留存数据。

name: metric
example: Which metric will tell us whether the feature succeeded?
exampleTrans: 哪个指标能告诉我们这个功能是否成功？

name: benchmark
example: We benchmarked our load time against three main competitors.
exampleTrans: 我们把加载时间与三家主要竞品做了对标。

name: performance
example: Performance on older Android phones is still too slow.
exampleTrans: 在旧款安卓手机上的性能仍然太慢。

name: reliability
example: This quarter we are focusing on reliability, not new features.
exampleTrans: 本季度我们专注于稳定性，而不是新功能。

name: quality gate
example: The quality gate requires at least eighty percent coverage on new code.
exampleTrans: 质量门禁要求新代码覆盖率至少达到百分之八十。

name: approval
trans: n. 赞同，同意；批准，认可；好评，称许；（正式的）许可，批准
example: We discussed approval during today's meeting.
exampleTrans: 我们在今天的会议中讨论了approval。

name: approve
example: Once two people approve the change, you can merge it into main.
exampleTrans: 有两个人通过评审后，你就可以合并到主分支。

name: reviewer
example: I added you as a reviewer because you know the billing code best.
exampleTrans: 我把你加为评审人，因为你最熟悉计费代码。

name: push back
example: Engineering pushed back on the deadline as unrealistic.
exampleTrans: 研发对截止日期提出异议，认为不现实。

name: negotiate
example: I negotiated a smaller scope so we could keep the date.
exampleTrans: 我协商缩小了范围，以便保住日期。

name: buy-in
example: We need buy-in from the sales team before changing pricing.
exampleTrans: 调整定价前我们需要获得销售团队的支持。

name: consensus
example: We reached consensus on cutting the reports feature.
exampleTrans: 我们就砍掉报表功能达成了共识。

name: executive
example: The executive team wants a demo before the board meeting.
exampleTrans: 高管团队希望在董事会前看到演示。

name: leadership
example: Leadership approved extra headcount for the platform team.
exampleTrans: 领导层批准了平台团队增加编制。

name: headcount
example: Without more headcount we have to cut a roadmap item.
exampleTrans: 没有更多编制，我们只能砍掉一个路线图事项。

name: vendor

exampleTrans: 我们正在评估两家支付网关供应商。

name: renewal

exampleTrans: 三家企业客户的续约取决于审计日志功能的上线。
